title: Line sketch: Fiery Vortex
description: Black-and-white ink line sketch on white paper — pure contour and edge drawing with no color fills. Edge-traced line art of: An abstract vortex of swirling flames radiates from a bright central point, blending, and into surrounding forms. The composition creates explosive radial movement with fluid, organic shapes. Thick, dynamic and blended color transitions suggest energetic pouring or palette-knife techniques (derived from painting #72).
